main_text.head: HOMILIA XII.
Samaritae abfterrent Iudaeos ab aedificio templi, & conducunt confiliarios contra eos.
main_text.p: 4 Populus autem(eius)regionis diffoluebat manus populi Iehudah,& perturbabat eos ne aedificarent.
5 Et conduxerunt contra eos confiliarios,ut diffiparent confilium eorum omnibus diebus Chores Regis Paras,& vsq; ad regnum Dariaues Regis Paras.
6 Quum autem regnaret Ahasueros,in principio regni eius scripserunt accusationem contra habitatores Iehudah & Ierusalaim,
7 Nam in diebus Arthahsasthe scripsit in pace Mithredath, Tabel,&reliqui socij eius,ad Arthahsaft he Regem Paras: porro scriptura(eius)epistolae scripta erat Syriace,& explicata Syriace.
8 Rehum a comentarijs, & Simsai scriba scripse runt epistolam vnam contra Ierusalaim ad Arthahsaft he Regem,huiusmodi.
9 Tunc Rehum a commentarijs,& Simsai scri- ba,& reliqui socij eorum, Dinaie,& Apharsathchaie, Tarpelaie, Apharsaie, Archauaie, Bablaie, Susan- chaie,Dehaue,Elmaie,
10 Et reliqui populi quos transtulit Asuappar magnus & gloriosus, & habitare fecit eos in vrbibus Samariae, & reliqui(populi qui sunt) trans Flumen,& Cheeneth.

CVm Iudaei aedificium templi inchoassent, coniunxerunt se illis Samaritani, suam quoq; operam in aedificando eis promittentes, at illi noluerunt eos admittere. Sciebant enim quod non aedificare vellent,sed eos potius,exploratis eorum con silijs,impedire ac opprimere.

page.notes: Printed text is dense and some letters in the Hebrew-transliterated proper names are uncertain; "Quid" at the foot is a catchword. The running head reads "CAP.IIII." at the left and "IN LIBRVM ESDRAE" centred; the page number is taken from the head. Some words in verses 7-10 may contain small print errors left as printed.
